trigger: User-uploaded real-person/self photo used as subject or both; image role alone is not regeneration consent.
allowed_without_approval: place on a new generated background
conservative color matching that preserves appearance
prohibited_without_approval: alter facial features, hairstyle or body
generate new clothes, pose or expression
turn the person into a fictional or cartoon character
outpaint the person or use character reference to recreate them

approval_spec.meaning: Explicit consent must refer to the exact photo and particular edit; general style preference is never consent.

host_limit: Whole-image image-generation editing can unintentionally re-create the subject. If pixel-accurate preservation cannot be guaranteed, use non-generative compositing or explain the limitation and do not make the edit.
abc_requirement: Keep exactly same original photo pixels per person across A/B/C, vary backgrounds/typography and layout only.
confidence: Recognition of real photos depends on host vision / explicit asset metadata. The local compiler is not a photo detector.
